# Affliction Warlock — Raid (group)

[Warlock](../README.md) > [Raid (group)](README.md) > Affliction

**✅ Recommended** for raid (the best warlock spec here, or within 3% of it).

**[Affliction — Wrack](../research/raid/builds/affliction-wrack-raid.md)** (35/11/5) — [open the talent tree](https://talentsforever.com/warlock/60/25500020135201351-0050203001-05-12)

## How to play

**Setup, before the pull:** **Summon Imp**, then **Demonic Sacrifice** it: you fight with its buff and no demon, which the rotation below assumes. Keep **Demon Armor** on you.

**Before the pull:** **Shadow Bolt**.

**Talents with no line below:** **Demonic Sacrifice**: before the pull, summon your Imp and sacrifice it (+15% Shadow damage: Forever swapped Classic's aspects, so the Imp, not the Succubus, is the Shadow sacrifice for 2 hours; summoning any demon cancels it).

**Then press the first one that is ready**, top to bottom:

1. **Amplify Curse** when Bane of Agony is not on the target, until the last 12 seconds of the fight; no global cooldown, so press it alongside the others
2. **Bane of Agony**: keep it on the target, until the last 12 seconds of the fight
3. **Corruption**: keep it on the target
4. **Siphon Life**: keep it on the target, when Shadow Vulnerability is not on the target
5. **Shadow Bolt** when Shadow Trance is active
6. **Wrack**; stop it when 2 ticks of it have landed and Corruption is not on the target or 2 ticks of it have landed and Bane of Agony is not on the target and Bane of Doom is not on the target

**Advanced: your cooldowns and extras.** Once the list above feels easy, add these:

- **Death Coil**: in the last 3 seconds of the fight, when there is no time left for another **Shadow Bolt**
- **Curse of the Elements**: about 1 time a fight
- **Life Tap**: now and then (in about 1 of 18 fights)

*The simulator's full rotation for this build, with every condition: [research rotation page](../research/raid/rotation.md).*

## Why this rotation

You fight without a demon: before the pull you sacrifice the Imp with **Demonic Sacrifice**. In the fight you keep **Curse of the Elements**, **Bane of Agony**, **Corruption** and **Siphon Life** on the boss and channel **Wrack** whenever none of them needs putting back: while you channel it, your three damage-over-time spells tick twice as fast. This is the official simulator's own Aff (Wrack) rotation, played with its own build and options since 2026-11-19, with two changes from our rotation search of 2026-11-20: the curse and the dots come before the trinkets and potions, and Weakness Analyzer is used whenever it is ready (together +0.6% for this build in a full raid on a third seed). In a 3-minute raid fight: **Wrack** 28 channels, **Corruption** 10 casts, **Shadow Bolt** 8, **Bane of Agony** 8, **Siphon Life** 5, and **Curse of the Elements**, **Amplify Curse** and **Death Coil** about once each; **Wrack** 37% of the damage, **Bane of Agony** 26%, **Corruption** 23%, **Siphon Life** 7%, **Shadow Bolt** 6%.

**Why it works**

- Before the pull: **Summon Imp**, then **Demonic Sacrifice**: +15% Shadow damage for 2 hours (Forever swapped Classic's aspects, so the Imp is the Shadow sacrifice). Summoning any demon ends it, so you play the fight without one. The 11 Demonology points are there for the sacrifice: of the points on the way only **Fel Vitality** (15% more mana) adds anything, and the simulator finds no change without **Demonic Embrace** or **Demonic Aegis**. Then start a **Shadow Bolt** so it lands as the fight begins.
- **Curse of the Elements** comes first, about once a fight: 5 minutes of 10% more magic damage taken, Shadow included (Curse of Shadow is gone in Forever). The simulator turns the raid's own copy of the curse off and leaves it to you. It is a Curse and **Bane of Agony** is a Bane, so both stay on the boss together.
- Then the dots, each only once it is off the boss: **Amplify Curse** and **Bane of Agony** while more than 12 seconds of the fight are left, **Corruption** while more than 9 are left, **Siphon Life** while more than its own 30 seconds are left. **Bane of Agony** starts weak and builds up over its 24 seconds, so it is never refreshed early; **Amplify Curse** (off the global cooldown, a 3-minute cooldown, so once a fight) makes it 50% stronger and **Improved Bane of Agony** adds 10%. **Corruption** is instant with 5 points in **Improved Corruption**.
- **Siphon Life** waits for the channel: the list never breaks a **Wrack** for it, and it holds it while Shadow Vulnerability, your **Improved Shadow Bolt** debuff, is on the boss.
- **Wrack** is the filler. While you channel it, your **Corruption**, **Bane of Agony** and **Siphon Life** on the boss deal their periodic damage 100% faster (in the simulator every extra tick is a full one and each dot still ends when it would have), and **Soul Siphon** (3 points) adds 12% to **Wrack** for each of those three dots on the boss, up to 36%. So the dots go up first and you channel the rest of the time: **Wrack**'s own hits are 37% of your damage, and the three dots, which tick twice as fast under it, another 55%. A channel costs 200 mana for 6 seconds.
- A channel ends early, after at least 2 ticks, when **Corruption** has fallen off the boss, or **Bane of Agony** has (with no **Bane of Doom** up): you put the dot back and channel again.
- In the fight, **Shadow Bolt** only with a Shadow Trance: **Nightfall** (2 points) gives each **Corruption** and **Wrack** tick a 4% chance to make your next **Shadow Bolt** instant, and the list casts it before the next channel. Its crits put **Improved Shadow Bolt**'s 20% more Shadow damage from you on the boss for 12 seconds, **Wrack** and the dots included; **Malevolence** adds 5% to your Shadow crit chance, **Shadow Mastery** 10% to your Shadow damage, and **Pandemic** doubles the crit bonus of **Wrack** and your dots.
- **Life Tap** only below 1,800 mana or 30% with more than a minute left, or when you cannot pay for anything else: 0.06 taps a fight in a full raid, so **Improved Life Tap**'s 2 points change nothing there. **Death Coil** (instant) goes in at the end, when a **Shadow Bolt** started then would land too late.
- The simulated gear holds two on-use trinkets: Talisman of Ephemeral Power goes with the other cooldowns (twice a fight) and Weakness Analyzer whenever it is ready (once).

**Caveats**

- No demon: summoning any demon ends **Demonic Sacrifice**'s 15%. If you die, summon the Imp and sacrifice it again before the next pull.
- Moving: **Wrack** is a channel and moving ends it. Your dots, **Curse of the Elements**, **Amplify Curse**, **Death Coil**, **Life Tap** and a Shadow Trance **Shadow Bolt** are instant: use them on the move, and channel again as soon as you stand still, since the dots tick faster only while you channel.
- The simulator's authors measured in game how the faster ticks start when you begin a **Wrack** (their evidence note EV-0085); what happens at the instant a channel ends is their assumption, not yet measured.
- Several targets (the simulated fights are one boss): with two or more the list puts **Bane of Doom** on your target while more than a minute is left, spreads **Bane of Agony** (on up to four targets, the first with **Amplify Curse**) and **Corruption** over the others, changing target to place them, and casts no **Siphon Life**.
- Ranks: the list casts **Corruption** at rank 6 and **Shadow Bolt** at rank 9, the trainer's top ranks: the books for **Corruption** rank 7 and **Shadow Bolt** rank 10 are not in Forever on the evidence there is (2026-11-20; checked again when the raids open on 2026-12-09).
- The official list also times Frozen Heart of the Mountain, a Major Spellblasting Potion and the racials Eureka! and Blood Fury to your dots (its **Siphon Life** line also waits while Blood Fury, the orc racial, is up). The simulated setup has none of them (a gnome with racials off, Major Mana Potions), so the list above leaves those conditions out.
- The 30/0/21 builds under "Builds that play as a hybrid" play another list, SM/Ruin, which leads with **Bane of Doom** and fills with **Shadow Bolt**: see the Shadow Bolt hybrid page.

**When to change it**

- Near the end: the list starts no **Bane of Agony** in the last 12 seconds, no **Corruption** in the last 9 and no **Siphon Life** in the last 30. Keep channelling **Wrack**, and use **Death Coil** when a **Shadow Bolt** would no longer land.
- A boss needs only one **Curse of the Elements** (in Classic two never stacked): if another warlock keeps it up, take the curse your raid gives you, such as **Curse of Recklessness** for the physical fighters or **Curse of Tongues** on a caster boss.
